wacc.formula: WACC = wₑ × kₑ + w_d × k_d × (1 − t);  kₑ = r_f + β × ERP
steps: β (Blume-adjusted) = 0.67 × raw β — + 0.33 = 1.00  (fewer than 52 weeks of prices: beta 1.0 assumed)
k_d = 6.37%  (5-year Treasury 4.91% + model spread 146 bp (bond-calibrated, app/debt.py)); after tax 6.37% × (1 − 24%) = 4.83%

methods.formula: FCFF = EBIT × (1 − t) + D&A − capex − ΔWC;  EV = Σ FCFF/(1+WACC)^t + TV/(1+WACC)^5;  TV = NOPAT₆ × (1 − g ÷ ROIC) ÷ (WACC − g);  value = (EV − debt + cash − claims) ÷ shares
steps: growth by year 5%, 5%, 4%, 4%, 3%; EBIT margin 19.0%; D&A 15.1% of revenue; capex 2.5% of revenue; ΔWC 10% of each revenue increase

methods.formula: Graham number = √(22.5 × EPS × book value per share);  22.5 = a P/E of 15 × a P/B of 1.5
